title: ECM Parameter Set (ECM-PS)
description: Open exchange format for equivalent-circuit-model parameters, deliberately styled after BPX (github.com/FaradayInstitution/BPX): Header/Parameterisation/State/Validation sections, natural-language parameter names with bracketed SI units, and scalar-or-interpolated-table values, so that ECM-PS documents read as the ECM counterpart of a BPX file and could fold into BPX if it adopts an ECM model type. Conventions fixed by this spec (not declared per file, as in BPX): SoC is a 0..1 fraction; temperatures are Kelvin; circuit parameters are functions of SoC (1-D tables) or of (SoC, temperature) (2-D tables); no executable expression strings (documents, not engines). Semantic grounding lives at spec level: each defined parameter name maps to an emmo/domain/equivalent-circuit-model class, and Header carries an optional BattINFO record IRI. DRAFT 0.2 -- $id namespace pending the w3id/EMMO decision.

ECM-PS version.description: Version of this format. Plays the role of BPX's 'BPX' version field; a distinct key so an ECM-PS file never claims BPX conformance.

Model.description: Model type, mirroring BPX Header.Model ('SPM' | 'SPMe' | 'DFN' | ...). 'ECM' denotes a Thevenin-style equivalent circuit: R0 in series with N parallel-RC branches and an OCV source.

References.description: Citations for the parameter values (e.g. a dataset DOI).

BattINFO record.description: IRI of the BattINFO cell / cell-spec record this ECM abstracts (extension beyond BPX).

Reference temperature [K].description: Temperature the single-OCV projection and similar reductions refer to when a consumer must pick one.

Number of RC elements.description: N parallel-RC branches. -> PyBaMM option 'number of rc elements'. The Circuit section MUST define R{i}/C{i} for i = 1..N.

Circuit.description: The circuit-element parameters. Each value is a number (constant), a 1-D InterpolatedTable over SoC, or a 2-D InterpolatedTable2D over (SoC, temperature [K]). Either 'Open-circuit voltage [V]' or both hysteresis branches MUST be present. Defined names map to emmo/domain/equivalent-circuit-model classes; consumers MUST ignore none and reject unknown names (additionalProperties false).

Open-circuit voltage on charge [V].description: OCV hysteresis charge branch (About:Energy one-state convention). Consumers targeting a single-OCV solver project the branches (e.g. by averaging) and SHOULD surface that loss.

Hysteresis decay rate.description: Dimensionless gamma of the one-state hysteresis model; meaningful only when both OCV branches are present.

Diffusion time constant [s].description: Optional Warburg-like diffusion element. -> PyBaMM diffusion-element option.

^R[1-9][0-9]* \\[Ohm\\]$.description: Polarization resistance of RC branch i. -> PyBaMM 'R{i} [Ohm]'.

^C[1-9][0-9]* \\[F\\]$.description: Polarization capacitance of RC branch i. -> PyBaMM 'C{i} [F]'.

User-defined.description: Free extension section, as in BPX. Vendor- or tool-specific facts (including per-parameter fitting metadata or semantic annotations) live here without forking the schema.

State.description: OPTIONAL initial simulation state, mirroring BPX's State section. Not cell parameters.

Validation.description: OPTIONAL named validation experiments, mirroring BPX's Validation section. Shape intentionally unconstrained in this draft.

Function.description: A parameter value: a constant, a 1-D table over SoC, or a 2-D table over (SoC, temperature [K]). Executable expression strings are deliberately NOT part of ECM-PS.

InterpolatedTable.description: As in BPX: a function defined by interpolation over x. For Circuit parameters, x is SoC (0..1 fraction).

InterpolatedTable2D.description: Natural 2-D extension of BPX's InterpolatedTable: z[i][j] is the value at temperature y[i] and SoC x[j].

z.description: One row per y value, one column per x value.
